metadata.description: Agent-use-ready US equity investment-intelligence skills and plugins for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, OpenClaw, Goose, and Claude Cowork. Backed by agentii.ai's data API (SEC filings, XBRL facts, earnings calendar) with three-layer retrieval protocol, code-mode office output (openpyxl/python-pptx + LibreOffice), and workspace memory architecture (v3.3.0).

plugins.name: agentii
plugins.description: Unified meta-plugin — the full agentii skill namespace (14 verticals, 80 skills) under a single /agentii:skill-name namespace. The recommended single install. Skills with same-name vertical variants (e.g., bio-pharm's med-adapted earnings-preview) ship via their own vertical plugins.

plugins.name: equity-research-core
plugins.description: 9 equity-research dimension skills with ~48 addressable sub-prompt modes: recent-quarter performance, business-model analysis, competitive landscape, growth strategy, secular tech trends, turnaround analysis, risk analysis, earnings sentiment, and valuation methods.

plugins.name: business-intelligence
plugins.description: 4 business-intelligence skills: revenue decomposition, unit economics, what-if scenarios, and operational KPI tracking.

plugins.name: industry-analysis
plugins.description: 4 industry-analysis skills: peer benchmarking, sector overview, competitive positioning, and supply-chain mapping.

plugins.name: models-and-pitches
plugins.description: 9 financial-modeling + presentation skills: DCF, comps, 3-statement, LBO, SOTP-valuation, audit-xls, xlsx-financials, earnings-preview, and pitch-deck. All Excel-producing skills follow the FR-044 4-step office protocol (spec → build → recalc → audit).

plugins.name: quantitative-analysis
plugins.description: 5 quantitative-analysis skills: ratio-analysis, PEG-valuation, reverse-DCF, DDM-valuation, and residual-income / EVA.

plugins.name: agentii-equity-agent
plugins.description: Orchestrating agent plugin with capability-isolated subagents (retrieval, analytical, BI, visualization) and a three-layer retrieval protocol system prompt.

plugins.name: bio-pharm
plugins.description: 15 med-sector skills (spec 052): fda-catalyst-{devices,medicines,vaccines} (dated PDUFA/AdCom/device catalyst calendars), pipeline-{devices,medicines,vaccines} (risk-adjusted pipeline + runway), trial-readout-analysis (AdCom-style six-axis scrutiny), market-share-tracking, med-market-sizing, med-event-takeaways, ct-status-diff, plus med-adapted sector-overview-med, peer-bench-med, earnings-preview-med and recent-quarter-med. Naming rule: same-name sector adaptations use {base}-{sector} suffixes. Backed by the med knowledge base (130 strategies / 320 cases) and the structured AdCom calendar (122 meetings).

plugins.name: idea-generation
plugins.description: 5 idea-generation skills: macro-idea-generation, qualitative-filtering, quantitative-screening, trade-idea-generation, trade-template.

plugins.name: macro-strategy
plugins.description: 4 macro-strategy skills: currency-analysis, leading-indicators, macro-regime, rate-cycle.

plugins.name: options-derivatives
plugins.description: 5 options & derivatives skills: options-foundations, income-strategies, volatility-trading, price-action-options, technical-execution. (A sixth, `options-strategies`, was retired upstream and is no longer shipped.)

plugins.name: portfolio-strategy
plugins.description: 4 portfolio-strategy skills: long-short-construction, long-short-equity, portfolio-hedging, position-sizing.

plugins.name: risk-and-psychology
plugins.description: Risk-and-psychology skill (trading psychology and risk discipline).

plugins.name: technical-analysis
plugins.description: 4 technical-analysis skills: chart-patterns, price-action, trade-execution, options-execution.

plugins.name: trading-as-business
plugins.description: Trading-as-business skill (running trading as a disciplined business).
